subject: general
question:
Which of the following are uses of bleaching powder?

(i) For disinfecting drinking water supply.

(ii) For the manufacture of chloroform.

(ii) For making wool unshrinkable.
solution:
The correct answer is __**i, ii and iii**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bleaching powder is used for **disinfecting drinking water supply**.
 
• It is also used in the **manufacture of chloroform**.
 
• Additionally, bleaching powder can be used for **making wool unshrinkable**.
 
• Therefore, the correct options are **i, ii, and iii**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bleaching powder is chemically known as **calcium hypochlorite**.
 
• It is widely used in water treatment plants to ensure the supply of clean and safe drinking water.
 
• Bleaching powder is also used in the** textile industry** to bleach fabrics and make them less prone to shrinking.
 
• In addition to these uses, it is also an important chemical in organic synthesis, such as in the production of chloroform.
